metrics.name: U.S. utility-scale net electricity generation
metrics.geography_name: United States (50 states and District of Columbia)
metrics.unit_conversion: 1 billion kWh = 1 TWh; numeric value unchanged
metrics.source: U.S. Energy Information Administration, Monthly Energy Review, Table 7.1
metrics.attribution: Economy-wide electricity activity; includes non-AI use and is not a data-center or AI electricity estimate.
metrics.evidence_notes: Includes utility-scale generation across the electric power, commercial and industrial sectors. Excludes small-scale solar PV, which EIA reports separately in Table10.6. No attribution to AI; seasonality and weather influence activity.
metrics.date_convention: Month-end denotes the reporting month, not publication date; amounts are monthly energy flows, not power capacity.

metrics.name: U.S. electricity sales to ultimate customers
metrics.geography_name: United States (50 states and District of Columbia)
metrics.unit_conversion: 1 billion kWh = 1 TWh; numeric value unchanged
metrics.source: U.S. Energy Information Administration, Monthly Energy Review, Table 7.1
metrics.attribution: Economy-wide electricity activity; includes non-AI use and is not a data-center or AI electricity estimate.
metrics.evidence_notes: Electricity sold by utilities and other energy service providers to end customers across sectors. Excludes self-generated direct use. This is electricity volume, not revenue. No attribution to AI; seasonality and weather influence activity.
metrics.date_convention: Month-end denotes the reporting month, not publication date; amounts are monthly energy flows, not power capacity.

parser_instructions: GET the public CSV URL; no API key needed. Decode UTF-8 and use csv.DictReader with exact header MSN,YYYYMM,Value,Column_Order,Description,Unit.
Select ELETPUS for total utility-scale net generation and ESTCPUS for electricity sales to ultimate customers. These are distinct physical flows and should not be summed.
YYYYMM rows ending13 are annual totals; exclude them from the monthly series. Retain months01 through12, year2019 onward. Convert observation month to month-end if the dashboard expects YYYY-MM-DD.
Require unit Billion Kilowatthours. Values already equal TWh numerically, so no conversion factor is needed.
Not Available is a missing value, never zero. Reject nonfinite values and duplicate monthly dates. Preserve gaps and sort dates.
Archive full source and replace the selected-series snapshot on successful refresh to capture official revisions. The CSV currently ends May2026; do not forward-fill.

The CSV omits PDF estimate/forecast markers. Table7.1 includes estimates and forecasts in certain other series; avoid indiscriminately importing all series as actual observations. Total generation and sales were confirmed against the current August2026 PDF table. Neither has a forecast marker at the latest month.

ELTCPUS total end-use includes estimated direct use in recent months; omitted from this actual-activity asset. ELI5PUS measures industrial-sector generation, not industrial electricity demand, and must not be mislabeled.
